title: confirmed-XI/post-lineup late-pre-match zero-label PIT source gate
target: Determine whether a historical source can prove that the confirmed starting XI was actually available before kickoff at an explicit late-pre-match prediction time.
required_pit_properties: source-specific timestamp proving when lineup first became available or an immutable archived snapshot before kickoff
prediction time explicitly after lineup publication
coverage large enough for rolling OOS development
no use of post-match player ratings, final statistics or later lineup corrections in pre-match features

evidence: Official documentation says /fixtures/lineups returns starting XI, formation and bench.
Lineups typically become available roughly 20-40 minutes before kickoff, with competition-dependent variation; some competitions may publish only after the game.

The standard historical lineup response is a final data object and the documentation does not expose an immutable per-fixture first-published-at timestamp for the lineup itself. Therefore a later historical fetch cannot by itself prove PIT availability.
Official docs expose fixture lineups with starters, substitutes, formations and positions.
For covered competitions, lineups are empty before confirmation and can appear around 60-75 minutes before kickoff in documented examples.

Fixture last_processed_at/latest-updated metadata is not documented as an immutable lineup-first-publication timestamp, so a final historical fixture response cannot establish exact PIT lineup availability without archived polling snapshots.

providers.provider: Sportradar / IMG Arena soccer lineup feed
evidence: Official live-feed documentation states lineup messages are sent when available and again whenever lineups change, which is PIT-compatible if the message stream is archived with receipt timestamps.
No accessible historical archive entitlement or public replay was established in this audit.

scientific_interpretation: Confirmed XI is a plausible late-pre-match information axis, but ordinary historical lineup endpoints are insufficient for strict PIT unless the first publication time is preserved. Using final historical XI without that proof would leak future information. A valid route requires archived provider snapshots/message timestamps or prospective collection beginning before kickoff.
next_options: obtain authenticated provider access that preserves historical lineup publication/message timestamps
start prospective pre-match lineup polling with immutable receipt timestamps for future matches
return to dynamic multi-line OU once a historical odds credential is supplied
